title: Northgate Card Requested Credit Line Increases — Review Decision and Limit Change
content:
A cardholder of a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account may request a credit line increase. A requested credit line increase on a Northgate Card account is reviewed on the account as it stands at the review, and the review sets the new credit limit; it is considered only when the base rule's account-age and active-status conditions hold — that is, the account has been open at least the tier's credit line review months, and it is in active status.

**Business effect.** When the review grants an increase, the account's credit limit is replaced by the new credit limit the review sets. The cardholder can then charge up to the new limit, and the account shows it as its current credit limit.

## Invocation: `raise_credit_limit_a1e4ca90`

Setting the new limit is an agent-side action. The agent unlocks `raise_credit_limit_a1e4ca90` with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`. One call replaces the account's credit limit with the stated amount.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | the reference number of the Northgate Card account whose limit changes, as the card account lookup returns it for this customer | id, text |
| `new_credit_limit_usd` | the new credit limit | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places; a whole-dollar amount is written with .00 |

The tool applies no rounding: it rejects an amount that is not in whole cents, and an amount of zero or below.

**Return.** A text receipt beginning "Credit limit changed" means the new limit is in effect. It gives the account reference, the previous credit limit and the new credit limit, in US dollars with two decimals.
